svg.text: AquaSDR analog front end · PA4 → 2nd-order Sallen-Key LPF → gain ×1.5 → scope
Butterworth fc ≈ 70.7 kHz (Q 0.72) · supply 5 V single · TLV9062 dual (U1A filter, U1B gain) · COMPUTED DESIGN, NOT A MEASUREMENT

g.text: D1 BAT54S: ADC_IN to GND and to 3V3
VBIAS = R11/R12 from Nucleo 3V3 = 1.65 V, C9 100 nF
U1 pin 8 = VCC, pin 4 = GND (TLV9062 SOIC-8)
VCC: Nucleo CN6 5V pin, USB powered. Abs max 6 V.
VMID = VCC/2 = 2.5 V sets stage-2 bias.
Test points: TP1 DAC_PA4 · TP2 FILTER_OUT · TP3 OPAMP_OUT · TP4 GND
Keep J1 ground and scope ground on one star point.
Only ADC_IN (after R10 + D1, JP1 on VBIAS) may go to a Nucleo pin.
Never OPAMP_OUT or an un-biased SCOPE_OUT.
